amendment1.note: Amendment 1's corrections stand. Amendment 2 builds on them and does not reinterpret them.

stage1ContractManifestAggregate.why: The aggregate covers every governed file. Writing it into a file the manifest itself hashes would be self-referential: recording it would change the value being recorded. It lives in exactly one place, on the manifest's own trailing `# aggregate` line, which the manifest excludes from its own file list.
